description: HYBRID TUNING APPROACH: Load weights from best model (epoch 96, 21.67 dB) with RESET optimizer state. Apply gradient stabilization tuning (50% reduced perceptual/RecFeat weights, 50% reduced LR, gradient clipping 5.0) to eliminate Generator Loss spikes (G=3716, G=3163) observed in parent training. Goal: Maintain 21.6+ dB PSNR with stable gradients (G < 500 consistently, no spikes > 1000).

experiment_metadata.methodology: Hybrid approach: Load pre-trained weights + Reset optimizer + Reduced loss weights + Gradient clipping
experiment_metadata.architecture: Enhanced Generator + Enhanced V2 Fixed Discriminator
experiment_metadata.novelty: Stabilized training through targeted hyperparameter tuning without losing learned features
experiment_metadata.training_strategy: Fine-tuning from best checkpoint with gradient-stabilized configuration

parent_experiment.name: dibco_transfer_resume_v1
parent_experiment.identified_issue: Perceptual loss gradient spikes causing Generator Loss explosions
parent_experiment.spike_frequency: ~7 severe spikes (G>2000) + 5 moderate spikes (G>1000) in 34 epochs
parent_experiment.spike_impact: Training inefficiency, risk of divergence, but PSNR remained stable

tuning_changes.optimizer_state: RESET (fresh Adam optimizer, no momentum baggage)
tuning_changes.rec_feat_weight: 10.0 → 5.0 (50% reduction, RecFeat also contributed to spikes)

hypothesis.root_cause: Perceptual loss (VGG features) produces occasional large gradients in late training, amplified by high loss weights (10.0) and accumulated optimizer momentum
hypothesis.expected_fix: 50% reduced weights + fresh optimizer + 5x gradient clipping = stable gradients
success_metrics: PSNR ≥ 21.60 dB maintained (within 0.07 dB of parent best)
Standard deviation of G_loss < 100 per epoch

success_criteria.acceptable: PSNR ≥ 21.60 dB + Generator Loss max < 1000 (no severe spikes)
success_criteria.target: PSNR ≥ 21.65 dB + Generator Loss max < 800 (no moderate spikes)
success_criteria.superior: PSNR ≥ 21.70 dB + Generator Loss mean < 400, std < 100 (fully stable)

risk_mitigation.psnr_degradation: If epoch 5 < 21.50 dB, tuning too conservative → increase weights to 7.5
risk_mitigation.persistent_spikes: If spike > 1500 still occurs → increase gradient_clip to 10.0
risk_mitigation.early_plateau: If no improvement by epoch 10 → early stopping will trigger
risk_mitigation.worse_than_parent: Always have parent ckpt-277 (21.67 dB) as fallback

critical_metrics: Generator Loss: mean, max, std per epoch
Perceptual Loss: mean, max per epoch
stop_conditions: Early stopping patience triggered (10 epochs no improvement)
PSNR < 21.50 dB for 3 consecutive epochs (tuning failed)
Target 21.70 dB reached with stable gradients (mission accomplished)
intervention_triggers: Epoch 5: If G_loss max > 1000 → investigate, may need stronger clipping
Epoch 5: If PSNR < 21.50 → weights too conservative, adjust
Epoch 10: If no improvement over parent → consider stopping
Epoch 15: Evaluate if continuing beneficial or plateau reached

comparison_baseline.training_stability: Unstable (7 severe spikes G>2000, 5 moderate G>1000)

theoretical_foundation.gradient_clipping: Prevents gradient explosion by capping gradient norm at 5.0
theoretical_foundation.loss_weight_reduction: Reduces magnitude of perceptual/RecFeat gradients by 50%
theoretical_foundation.lr_reduction: Smaller steps in late training prevent overshooting minima
theoretical_foundation.optimizer_reset: Removes accumulated momentum that may amplify instability
theoretical_foundation.combined_effect: Multi-pronged stabilization: clip large gradients, reduce gradient source, gentle updates, fresh dynamics

from_scratch_training.cons: 6-7 hours, may not reach 21.67 dB, wastes 90 epochs progress
from_scratch_training.decision: Rejected - inefficient for gradient stabilization goal

pure_resume.cons: Optimizer momentum amplifies spikes, no fix applied

gradient_clipping_only.cons: May not fully solve if loss weights still too high
gradient_clipping_only.decision: Rejected - insufficient, combined approach more robust

publication_relevance.research_question: Can GAN training stability be improved through targeted hyperparameter tuning without retraining from scratch?
publication_relevance.contribution: Demonstrates efficient fine-tuning methodology for stabilizing late-stage GAN training
publication_relevance.novelty_angle: Hybrid approach preserves learned features while resetting optimizer dynamics
publication_relevance.expected_claim: Achieved equivalent performance (21.6+ dB) with 5x improved training stability (no spikes > 1000 vs 7 spikes > 2000)
